nodes.label: Teal-Cyan-Blue Gradient Palette
nodes.rationale: Ring gradient flows from emerald/teal (bottom-left) through cyan to soft blue (top-right); core is cyan, satellite is pale cyan; high contrast on near-black background.

nodes.label: OmniRev App Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: Square 512x512 app icon with rounded-corner near-black (#0a0a0c) tile, sized for PWA/home-screen/app store use; dark background matches the Dark Hybrid landing theme.

nodes.label: Orbit Mark
nodes.rationale: Thick open ring (gap at upper right) with a solid central core circle and a small pale-cyan satellite dot sitting in the ring gap, evoking an orbiting body; suggests a recurring cycle / recovered revenue returning into orbit around a central account.

nodes.label: OmniRev Orbit Mark (Email)
nodes.rationale: Raster app-icon style mark for email headers: dark rounded-square tile with a cyan-to-teal gradient ring (open orbit arc) around a solid cyan center dot and a small satellite dot on the ring, evoking recovered revenue orbiting/returning. PNG used because email clients do not reliably render SVG.
